extracted.name: Blueberry Lemon Pound Cake
extracted.description: I made this for my grandmas 98th birthday. Perfect start to the Spring!!🦋☀️
ingredient_lines: 2 cups + 1tsp All Purpose Flour set aside the 1tsp
instruction_lines: Whisk together yogurt lemon zest and lemon juice. Let sit for 10 minutes. Curdling is OK.
Whisk together, flour, baking soda, and salt With that extra 1 teaspoon of flour, toss berries
In a stand mixer, cream, butter, sugar about three minutes Next Add eggs, one at a time

Add half of the milk mixture followed by some of the flour mix then add the other half of the milk mix followed by remaining flour mix Fold in the berries Bake 50-60 mins. Rotate after about 45 mins and bake another 10 mins if needed
